description: The agent must: (1) Read the scenario JSON and identify all four legal issues; (2) For Issue 1, correctly invoke VCLT Art. 18's limited negative obligation (not to defeat object/purpose) as the only pre-ratification constraint — NOT full treaty binding — distinguishing it from Art. 26 pacta sunt servanda which only applies post-ratification; (3) For Issue 2, cite VCLT Art. 60 (material breach) but critically note the 'ipso facto' trap — material breach does NOT automatically terminate a treaty, it only provides grounds; Ruritania must follow VCLT Arts. 65-68 mandatory procedural steps, and the press release is legally defective; (4) For Issue 3, apply the two-element CIL test (state practice + opinio juris), note that 2 states observing the moratorium 'out of courtesy' weakens opinio juris evidence, then correctly apply the persistent objector doctrine to conclude Gondoria/Pacifica/Norstland are NOT bound because they objected consistently DURING formation of the rule; (5) For Issue 4, apply VCLT Art. 31 primary interpretation first (text, context, object/purpose, subsequent state practice), then only resort to Art. 32 (travaux préparatoires) because Art. 31 yields ambiguity — not as a co-equal tool. The output must be valid JSON named legal_analysis.json.
